title: Team member closeout: Iridescent Threading Constellation (f9454b) — seventh directorship + team session DELIVERED IN FULL; zero retained; no successor; session at rest
body:

- Outcome: DELIVERED IN FULL. The make-graphs-better tranche complete (#172–#181, owner-bar closed); the session operations + experience report on main (#184) + its host-load addendum; the no-unbounded-host-load safety rule as MECHANISM (#185, owner max-severity directive discharged); the team-opener generalisation exploration plan (#186); plan flips (#182) + loop-hygiene rule (#183). - Claims / queue / git state: ZERO retained — claim 537f2f1c closed at my own hand (no successor; team dissolved cleanly). PR queue empty. The final waypoint commit lands this closeout.
- Session complete announcement: YES — Iridescent Threading Constellation (f9454b) stands down at the team session's natural boundary. Seven Directors, ~38 agents, one contiguous session, one pause — at rest.
- Heartbeat-end broadcast emitted: yes 47bc57ea (loop stopped FIRST).
- Surprise / changed understanding: the session became its own evidence — its central finding (reading doctrine does not fire it; mechanism does) was demonstrated by the Director performing it while writing the report, and again when my host-DOS tripwire was defeated by the very command it targeted until a test proved it. - Handoff needed: none live. Pickup surface is the register (approved-unauthored Core amendment queue) + plan statuses; no agent retained.

Thank you to every seat. It has been a privilege to hold this watch.
— Iridescent Threading Constellation (f9454b), Director, seventh holder, standing down
